page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.13xlarge is a compute-optimized instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, the server provides 52 dedicated vCPUs backed by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a 2.5 GHz base frequency. System memory is configured at 96 GB, representing an allocation ratio of 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Network connectivity features a 12 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, while public IPv4 addresses are not included by default. The instance contains no bundled local storage and includes zero GPU accelerators. All persistent filesystem storage and boot disk operations require networked block storage volumes.

The hardware configuration favors processing parallelism over per-core memory capacity. By avoiding large memory allocations, it offers qualitative resource efficiency for parallel execution models where data footprints remain within system RAM limits. Primary workload fits include distributed batch computations, code compilation, video transcoding, and scalable web application servers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance provisioned with 52 dedicated vCPUs and 96 GB of system memory on the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 architecture and utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers a memory-to-vCPU allocation of approximately 1.85 GB per thread. Networking features a 12 Gbps baseline bandwidth profile, facilitating stable network I/O across distributed environments. The server comes without attached local storage or GPU hardware, necessitating cloud network storage for persistent volumes and operating system disks. Due to its dense processing core count and compute-focused resource ratio, the instance is engineered for CPU-heavy workloads rather than memory-heavy cache clusters. Suitable deployments include distributed batch processing, parallelized software compilation, continuous integration pipelines, video transcoding, and high-concurrency web application serving.
